title: Bosun Graph Query Execution Result Contract v1
description: Strict JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 contract formalizing the canonical execution output shape for Vault Graph DSL queries, including matched nodes, resolved edges, reached traversal depth, execution duration, and optional subgraph adjacency matrices.

matched_nodes.description: Collection of graph node vertices matched or traversed during query execution.

resolved_edges.description: Collection of directed graph links resolved during query traversal.

depth_reached.description: Maximum traversal depth / hop distance reached during execution.

execution_duration_ms.description: Total query execution duration in milliseconds (wall-clock time).

subgraph_adjacency_matrix.description: Optional square adjacency matrix projection of the matched subgraph.

shortest_path.description: Optional ordered sequence of node URNs forming the point-to-point shortest path.

projections.description: List of projection identifiers requested and populated in this result payload.

metrics.description: Optional detailed performance telemetry or execution statistics.

uuidv7.description: Canonical UUIDv7 identifier, formatted as standard 36-char hex UUID string or urn:uuid:... URN.

urn.description: Canonical RFC 8141 URN (e.g. urn:yeoman:contact:<uuid>, urn:uuid:<uuid>, urn:careen:project:<uuid>).

matchedNode.description: Projected graph vertex attributes matched by the query.

id.description: Canonical entity URN uniquely identifying this note.

realm.description: Canonical realm identifier for this entity.

title.description: Human-readable note title or entity label.

depth.description: Traversal distance in hops from query origin.

resolvedEdge.description: Projected directed link connecting two vertices in the graph.

direction.description: Traversal direction relative to query origin.

weight.description: Optional edge traversal weight or affinity score.

subgraphAdjacencyMatrix.description: Adjacency matrix representation of the resolved subgraph.

nodes.description: Ordered array of node URN identifiers indexing rows and columns.

matrix.description: Square N x N adjacency matrix where matrix[i][j] represents edge connectivity from nodes[i] to nodes[j].

dimension.description: Dimension N of the square adjacency matrix.

directed.description: Whether the matrix represents a directed graph.
